---
title: cite
---



```python
cite(dataset, style='apa', ref=None)
```

How to cite a dataset: its recommended citation, then the credits its sources require.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                            | Default    |
|---------|--------|----------------------------------------|------------|
| dataset | str    | Dataset id                             | _required_ |
| style   | str    | ``"apa"`` (plain text) or ``"bibtex"`` | `'apa'`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                           |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | str    | A string; print it: ``print(geo.cite("<dataset>"))``. |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

```python
!pip install -q geo4bolivia
import geo4bolivia as geo
import plotly.express as px

print(geo.cite("sdg01"))                   # APA, then the sources' credits
print(geo.cite("sdg01", style="bibtex"))
```
